clauses.heading: FIRST AMENDMENT TO SENIOR REVOLVER LOAN AGREEMENT
clauses.text: THIS FIRST AMENDMENT TO SENIOR REVOLVER LOAN AGREEMENT, dated effective as of March 27, 2019 (the "First Amendment"), is entered into by and among EMPIRE LOUISIANA LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (the "Original Borrower" or "EL") and EMPIRE NORTH DAKOTA LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("END", together with the Original Borrower are sometimes referred to herein collectively as the "Borrower") and CROSSFIRST BANK, a Kansas state-chartered bank (the "Bank").
clauses.plain_english: This clause identifies the parties involved in the amendment to the existing loan agreement and establishes the effective date of the document.
clauses.risk_justification: Standard introductory clause identifying parties and the nature of the agreement.

comply with the QCR. Such principal payment shall be in addition to the
regularly scheduled interest payment.

hereby deleted.

clauses.heading: 12. Conditions Precedent.
clauses.text: The Borrower shall execute and deliver, or cause to be executed and delivered, to the Bank, each of the following as express conditions precedent to the effectiveness of the amendments and modifications contemplated by this First Amendment: (a) This First Amendment; (b) The replacement Promissory Note (Revolver Note); (c) The END Mortgages; (d) The END Security Agreements; (e) The Amended Louisiana Mortgage; (f) The Guaranty Agreement; (g) The obligation of Borrower to furnish the Bank with appropriate certificates from the State of North Dakota that demonstrate END is registered and qualified to do business in the State of North Dakota, shall be an express condition subsequent and must be accomplished by Borrower to the Bank's satisfaction no later than April 12, 2019, and failure of Borrower to timely satisfy such condition subsequent shall constitute an Event of Default hereunder without further or other notice from the Bank. (h) Payment to the Bank of the fully earned and non-refundable one percent (1.0%) loan origination fee in the amount of $76,900.00 concurrently herewith in immediately available funds (US Dollars); and (i) Closing certificates from each of the Borrowers.

summary.executive_summary: This First Amendment to the Senior Revolver Loan Agreement, effective March 27, 2019, modifies the existing credit facility between Empire Louisiana LLC, Empire North Dakota LLC, and CrossFirst Bank. The amendment increases the Revolver Commitment, establishes new fee structures including origination and amendment fees, and incorporates additional collateral from Empire North Dakota LLC. It also mandates specific financial reporting requirements and reaffirms the borrowers' obligations under the original loan documents. The agreement is governed by Oklahoma law and includes a waiver of jury trial and submission to Tulsa County jurisdiction.
key_points: Increase in Revolver Commitment Amount with a corresponding $76,900.00 loan origination fee.
Implementation of a Quarterly Commitment Reduction (QCR) of $150,000.00 per quarter starting June 30, 2019.
Borrower obligation to pay a 0.25% fee on the outstanding Revolver Commitment for any requested amendments.
Expansion of collateral to include real and personal property liens granted by Empire North Dakota LLC.
Consolidation of financial reporting and leverage ratio measurements based on Guarantor-provided statements.
Borrower waiver and release of all known and unknown claims against the Bank as of the effective date.

unusual_clauses: The Bank retains 'sole discretion' to determine if an amendment is required, which triggers a mandatory fee for the Borrower (Clause 7).
